title: A group scheme over a field is separated
statement: Let $k$ be a field and let $G$ be a group scheme over $k$ [def-sc-group-scheme]. Then the structure morphism $G\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ is separated [def-weil-proper-morphism]: its diagonal $G\to G\times_kG$ is a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion].
